full_name: National Eye Institute Visual Functioning Questionnaire-25 plus 14-item supplement (interview format)
domains: general health and vision (6 items); difficulty with activities (20 items); level of agreement with statements on problems due to vision loss (13 items)
response_scale: difficulty items 1-6 (no difficulty to stopped doing this because of eyesight; 6 = stopped for other reasons, scored missing); agreement items 5-point (agree all of the time to none of the time; definitely true to definitely false); 2 supplement items 0-10
scoring: Rasch rating scale model (Winsteps) person ability and item difficulty in logits; recommended 12-domain linear scoring not used; polarity reversed for items 17-25 and A11a-A13
target_population: patients with low vision (veterans in VA low-vision rehabilitation)
notes: 39 items administered but 34 analysed (3 driving items 15, 16, A10 and 2 0-10 items A1, A2 dropped; p9); directions modified to include low-vision devices (p8); interviewer administered (p7); only 7 of 34 items showed significant change after rehabilitation (Abstract p2)
